# Thunderbird Calendar architecture, Redux, and transaction documentation

Redux holds serializable source/draft/session state. Keep `calIEvent`, `calICalendar`, date objects, DOM nodes, and provider references outside it. Route generations, source request IDs, operation request IDs, and draft baseline identity reject stale work. Category Save registers `calendarEventCategorySaveField`, calls `event.setCategories(...)`, then writes through a Calendar transaction. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
